confidence_notes: The RBA rate comes from a search of the RBA site. Food and drink anchors rest on one aggregated search of crowdsourced Chania price indexes (Expatistan, Traveltables, MyLifeElsewhere, Nomad.watch, Unipage) and a 2026 taverna guide. These sources disagree and some are dated, so I took mid-values adjusted for July peak-season tourist pricing. Cocktail and wine are not directly sourced. I set cocktail at about 2x beer and wine at about 1.3x beer, based on typical Greek tourist-town relationships. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Crete and July peak demand. I did not search accommodation prices or inspect listings. Accommodation is the least certain group.
comparable_city_reasoning: Chania is a tourist-heavy Cretan harbour town. Prices are comparable to other Greek island and coastal tourist towns such as Heraklion, Rhodes Town and Nafplio, and are above the Greek mainland average in peak season.
